name: dk-skills
description: Skills for keeping a codebase honest: documentation that fails the build when it drifts, and reviews that catch the patterns the next agent will copy.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Build an Open Knowledge Format v0.2 knowledge bundle for a codebase, with a CI gate that fails when the documents no longer match the code they describe. Review a diff for broken windows: code or comments that a later agent will copy and so spread bad code.
